title: Best Stretch of Points
statement: A player's score changes each round by a positive or negative number of points. Return the largest total of any run of consecutive rounds (at least one round). Return null if there are no rounds.

answerKey.pattern: Single pass keeping the best total that ends at the current round (Kadane's idea)
keyPoints: For each round, the best run ending here either starts fresh or extends the previous run: max(x, current + x)
Keep the best total seen over all rounds
Start both values from the first round, not from 0, so all-negative input works
edgeCases: All values negative: the answer is the largest single value
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sum every start and end pair with a running sum: O(n^2)

hints: Summing every possible run is O(n^2). At each round, which runs ending there are worth keeping?
A run ending at this round either starts here or extends the best run ending at the previous round.
Start from the first value instead of 0, so an array of only negative numbers still works.
